proposals.evidence: User adjudication: follow Turner’s analysis of kab/kabe when as interrogative remodeling of the ēvam ēva series, explicitly crossed with ka. Turner gives Bengali kabe, Hindi kab/kabhī and western Pahari kεbε/kabhia. Platts’s competing kiyat-based explanation with jab/tab analogy remains an alternative; this is not an unmodified sound-law reflex of ēvam ēva.
